card.name: Partway through split-up words
card.fires_on: The first piece of a word that gets split up, such as the start of mesylate after a drug name, slurry, anhydrous or chia. The word is not yet finished at this point.

modes.label: Mesylate salt names
modes.description: The 'mes' piece after a drug name, before 'ylate'.

modes.label: Other split words
modes.description: The first piece of an ordinary word such as slurry, anhydrous, shelling or chia.
